data.title: 一色彩羽 · 学生会室小恶魔托腮的虚假拒绝·「前辈，这算是告白吗？对不起，我们是不可能的♪」
data.description: 【学生会会长室·放学后】名台词名场面立魂。彩羽坐在会长专属办公椅上，单手托着下巴，另一手在胸前做出婉拒手势。蜜糖色波浪卷发垂落，那双狡黠灵动的大眼睛眯成恶魔般的月牙，脸上挂着戏谑而甜蜜的招牌坏笑。
data.location: 总武高学生会办公室大班椅前
data.action: 单手托腮一手做拒绝手势，蜜茶波浪发轻垂，小恶魔坏笑挑逗
data.lighting: 橘红色晚霞打在桌案文件与制服领口上
data.camera: medium shot, seated in office chair, hand on chin, teasing gesture
data.promptProse: Iroha Isshiki leans back in the council-office swivel chair, one elbow on the mahogany desk and chin in her hand while the other hand makes a playful rejection gesture. Open navy blazer, cream cardigan and thin red ribbon retain the uniform beneath honey-brown wavy side-pigtails. The medium view includes desk papers and the office behind her. Orange-red sunset lights her mischievous eyes and collar, casting chair and paper-edge shadows across the desk.
